data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of 1,352.0 (USD millions). Using the gross claims development triangle (excluding the two most recent underwriting years), older underwriting years (2011-2013) show a net favourable development of approximately 61.5 (USD millions) (a release of ~4.55% of opening gross claims). The managing agent reports a net release of $146.4m (net of reinsurance) attributable mainly to positive movements in the energy and property classes; the difference between the gross release derived from the triangle and the reported net release reflects reinsurance recoveries and the report's net presentation of the movement.

data.data_quality_notes: The movement note in the report presents the prior year movement as a NET release of $146.4m (net of reinsurance). The note's figures appear to be net; the 'gross' prior year movement was not explicitly stated in that movement note. Per instructions, a gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (excluded the two most recent underwriting years) producing a gross release of -61.5 (USD millions). The discrepancy between the net release ($146.4) and the gross triangle-derived release (-61.5) is due to reinsurance recoveries and presentation differences. Lob movement amounts listed in the movement note appear to be net figures and have been included with lower confidence.
